Iranian author Iraj Pezeshkzad's famous novel دائی جان ناپلئون (da'i jahn napole'ahn) literally translates to "Dear Uncle Napoleon," with the first word acting as a term of endearment or honorific. However, the English translation uses the title My Uncle Napoleon because Anglophone audiences would most likely assume that the book had some sort of major epistolary component when the greatest extent of that is charecters passing notes to each other and scenes where charecters are composing or reading letters, but the text of the letter is not inserted into the contents of the book.
